title: Require Platform-Independent Service Source
forbids: Node or Bun acquisition, provider implementation imports, and app or plugin imports from service source
why: Services own semantic capability and policy over ready dependencies. Qualified apps own provider selection, acquisition, host composition, and process lifetime.
remediate: Move acquisition or host code to the qualified app or provider, expose a ready resource or public-client capability, and pass that value through the service construction face.
message: Service source must consume ready capabilities without acquiring a platform or provider.
